message: The residential security deposit is more than two months' rent under the Model Tenancy Act template. Local state law may differ, so verify the rule for the property's location.
source: Government of India, Model Tenancy Act 2021, section 11: https://www.mohua.gov.in/upload/whatsnew/60b7acb90a086Model-Tenancy-Act-English-02.06.2021.pdf
